Ravi: Repro on onboarding sample: after idle abort + reconnect we see duplicated trailing bytes causing JS/Go parity issues.
Dina: Which SDKs? sampleapp version?
Ravi: js-sdk@0.9.3, go-sdk@0.6.6, sampleapp main. Steps: open streaming example, let it idle ~11s, UI aborts, page reconnects. Captured SSE frames.
Marco: paste minimal frame trace.
Ravi: trace:
SSE id: 7
data: {"delta":"hello"}

SSE id: 8
data: {"delta":" world"}

-- abort/reconnect --
SSE id: 8
data: " world"
SSE id: 9
data: {"delta":"!"}
Result: JS concats and shows 'hello world world!' while Go treats second id:8 as a new event and drops overlap -> 'hello world!'.
Dina: Looks like reconnect didn't send Last-Event-Id so runtime replayed last event. Quick fix: sampleapp should forward Last-Event-Id on reconnect and relax idle timer.
Marco: SDK policy question: event-id dedupe vs byte coalescing. Propose default to event-id dedupe and expose StreamOptions.stitchPolicy = 'event-id'|'byte-coalesce'.
Ravi: I'll file INF-1102 with repro logs and open a sampleapp PR to increase idle timeout and forward last-event-id.
ci-bot: created INF-1102 and queued sampleapp PR review.
